title: Mexico | World Coffee Guide
description: Mexican coffee is usually mild and easy to drink, with chocolate and nut flavours, though the higher-grown lots can be much brighter than the country's reputation suggests. Most of it is washed arabica from Chiapas, Veracruz and Oaxaca, often shade grown and very often organic.
seoDescription: Mexico coffee guide: Chiapas, Veracruz, Oaxaca, washed arabica, USDA 2026/27 production.
